summary: UI/UX audit (findings only, no product/data edits) written to docs/audit/v19/ux.findings.json (40 findings, 12-key schema, schema-validated) and docs/audit/v19/ux.md (method, verdict/severity summary tables, gate coupling, limitations). Verdicts: 28 wrong / 2 suspect / 1 unverifiable-here / 9 ok; severity 2 critical / 13 major / 25 minor; basisKind 20 internal / 18 standard / 2 judgment. Two critical findings: (1) div.section-canvas-wrap[role=img] is an AX atom that hides four interactive controls incl. the only cortical-divisions toggle and the live-section selection label — the exact defect class this repo already fixed on the plate root (ax-delta.mjs:6-14, a11y-contract.mjs:207-208); (2) the 12 cranial-nerve records' authored `course` (876-1290 chars each) and `modality` fields (types.ts:84-85, README L39) have no renderer anywhere in src/components. Major: WCAG 2.5.3 on the four All-module buttons (measured via verify:area-toggles group 7, pinned at area-toggles.mjs:1385-1399 — gate-flip handoff for the integrator), --text-muted 3.73:1, vessel palette 2.14-2.82:1, .btn border 1.55:1/fill 1.08:1, dimmed tree rows 3.31/3.84:1, PiP glyph-named buttons (X/Y/Z/▴/×), tree selection state not exposed, 9/12 nerve contextNotes describing the retired v14 ellipsoid, the v14 anchorNote honesty text having no in-app surface, the undiscoverable live-section click gesture, and the header grid (--sidebar-w 320 vs literal 264px = 56px misalignment at <=1024px; 320px first column at <=640px breaks WCAG 1.4.10 reflow; documented flexBasis/marginLeft alignment mechanism absent from the code). Verified: evidence-contract command exits 0 (findings 40); node scripts/verify/a11y-contract.mjs exit 0 (38 passed/0 failed, incl. shipped-bundle reader); npm run verify:area-toggles exit 0 (472 assertions passed/0 failed) — first cold run aborted on a Windows file-lock EPERM in .plate-scratch cleanup with 0 assertion failures, noted in ux.md §6.2; all contrast ratios computed with the WCAG 2.1 formula from tokens.css and every suggested-fix value re-measured. No browser available, so no finding asserts a rendered pixel and one browser-dependent question is recorded as unverifiable-here.
